_meta.description: Wildlife/elephant warning reference points. These represent areas where elephant activity has been observed or reported — NOT live/current elephant locations. Additive only; does not modify the base OpenStreetMap GeoPackage. Mirrored in code at frontend/lib/features/map/heritage_map_screen.dart (kElephantWarningZones) — keep both in sync if edited.

areas.name: Elephant Warning Area 1
areas.description: Wild elephants may be present in this area. This is a reference point where elephant activity has been observed/reported, not a confirmed current location or a surveyed habitat boundary.

notes: No verified ecological habitat boundary or corridor geometry was available from an official source for these points, so no boundary/corridor polygon is stored — the 150m radius is a display-only approximate warning visualization, not a claimed habitat extent.

News reports (Daily Mirror, Lanka Newspapers — see docs/sigiriya_poi_dataset.md) confirm elephant activity and past incidents in the general Sigiriya/Pidurangala area, corroborating that a wildlife-warning layer is warranted here, but do not provide surveyed corridor coordinates.
